# ts-fsrs 5.2.3

`index.js` is the self-contained ESM distribution from the official published package `ts-fsrs@5.2.3`. The source-map trailer and trailing whitespace were removed. The original MIT license is included. Upstream identifies its model in this release as FSRS-6.0. The application uses its default 21 weights and default learning and relearning steps. Request retention is configurable in settings.
